bio.text: Ben Toews represents Idaho Senate District 4 and lives in Coeur d'Alene; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term.
The legislature biography describes Toews as a native Idahoan with an associate degree in political science from North Idaho College and a degree in international business from Gonzaga University.
According to the biography, Toews worked in a family specialty construction-tools business for 17 years, serving as vice president and later president and CEO, before selling the company in 2019.
